Mark brings over five years of customer service experience, including two years supporting Singapore-based clients in personal and commercial insurance. He enjoys helping people, building positive relationships, and making sure clients feel supported and understood.

Outside of work, Mark enjoys the simple things in life—spending time at the beach and playing badminton. He values staying active, enjoying the outdoors, and maintaining a healthy balance between work and life in the Philippines.
